name: Abandoned Greenhouse
description: A Victorian glasshouse lost to moss and leaves. Restore it and watch the garden bloom again.

discoveries.name: Glass Hummingbird
discoveries.description: A rare garden ornament, hand-blown glass. Found under the leaves.

discoveries.name: Gardener's Note
discoveries.description: "Whoever finds this: please look after my orchids." Hidden under the moss.

discoveries.name: Clean Rush Badge: Bloom
discoveries.description: The rarest badge, for those who restore nature itself.

contracts.title: Clear the Way
contracts.description: Clear the leaves and moss from the central path.

contracts.title: Let the Light In
contracts.description: Clean the glass walls so the sun can reach the plants again.

contracts.title: Greenhouse Reborn
contracts.description: Restore everything: glass, planters, furniture, path, leaves and rubbish.
